messages:
sarah: Heads-up — deploybot shows the runtime/SKD pin for quantized longseq models will auto-expire in tonight's change window. Need a quick sync: do we lift the lock or extend?

deploybot: automated note — pinlist entry runtime=2.14 locked for model-group=quant-longseq expires=2248123456. Canary history: 3 runs, 0.4% error, median p50 latency +6ms.

paul_infra: I want to lift if we can gate it behind a strict canary + fallback. Last outage was caused by an unexpected KV cache mismatch with quantized weights.

deepa: Agree. Proposal: 5% canary in us-west-2 for 45m, keep fallback to runtime=2.13 + SDK=1.8. Also add a quick eval suite run against our regression prompt set before full rollout.

jonah_release: +1 on the canary. Can we also pin the SDK to 1.9 for the canary hosts only? That lets us validate SDK/runtime handshake changes without a global SDK bump.

mike_sre: Concern: if the canary shows a tokenization drift we might need to roll back immediately. Suggest alert thresholds: error rate >0.7% OR latency p90 increase >15% triggers auto-rollback. Are those thresholds acceptable?

ops-oncall: Those thresholds look fine. Add synthetic traffic that mimics longseq tails — we saw problems only at >8k context. Also enable trace sampling = 100% for canary for 30m.

paul_infra: Good. I'll prepare the canary manifest. Snippet below for deploybot to apply:

```
canary:
  regions: ["us-west-2"]
  pct: 5
  duration: 45m
  trace_sampling: 1.0
fallback:
  runtime: "2.13"
  sdk: "1.8"
preflight:
  eval_suite: "regression-longseq-v2"
  synthetic_profile: "longtail-8k"
rollback_criteria:
  error_rate_pct: 0.7
  p90_latency_increase_pct: 15
```

jonah_release: Also add a release-notes blurb that mentions: "runtime 2.14: KV cache semantics tightened for quantized ops; may affect long-sequence caching. Recommend conservative batching and monitoring."

deepa: I'll author the release note and the eval checklist. Who will run the preflight eval?

paul_infra: I'll kick the preflight at +30m so it finishes before canary start. ops-oncall please stand by to watch traces.

ops-oncall: Standing by. I created an alert channel #canary-watch and added retention logging to S3 path s3://redwood-canary/runtime-2-14/2248123456.

deploybot: action queued — apply canary manifest when user `paul_infra` reacts with :rocket:. Will post status updates in this thread.

sarah: I'll be online during the window. If canary passes, plan to roll 50% after 2h, then 100% after 12h with a hold at each step. If any major regression, fallback to runtime=2.13 immediate.

mike_sre: One more ask — make a quick compatibility matrix in the rollforward doc: model variants that require SDK >=1.9, quant profiles, and expected perf delta. Saves time if we need to triage.

paul_infra: Noted. I'll update the rollout doc and ping here when the canary manifest is applied.

deploybot: deploybot update — preflight eval started by paul_infra (eval id: preflight-2248123456). Will report results here.

deploybot: preflight complete — regressions: 0/250 prompts fail, latency delta p50 +4ms, p90 +9ms, artifacts uploaded.

paul_infra: preflight clean. Applying canary now. :rocket:

deploybot: canary started — 5% traffic in us-west-2. Monitoring channel: #canary-watch.

ops-oncall: Initial traces look fine. No tokenization mismatches in first 20m.

jonah_release: tagging docs: runtime-2.14 -> rollout step=canary by paul_infra. Release notes draft: added to /docs/releases/runtime-2.14.md

mike_sre: Keep an eye on tail errors. If we hit error_rate >0.7% or p90 >15% we'll let deploybot run rollback.

deploybot: canary update @everyone — 30m elapsed: error_rate 0.35%, p90 +10%. No rollback triggered.

paul_infra: proceeding to 50% after 10m hold.

deploybot: rollout update — 50% applied. Next hold = 2h.

sarah: thanks team. Closing thread for now; will post final status when we complete 100% or if rollback happens. :thumbsup:
